capabilities.name: Limited-mode editing and redaction refusal

decision.rationale: A daily-driver editor must not silently corrupt or insecurely redact a feature it cannot safely handle.

capabilities.notes: View with a clear limitation; refuse the edit/redaction on attempt and identify the blocking feature.

knownLimitations: View with a clear limitation; refuse the edit/redaction on attempt and identify the blocking feature.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Unapplied-redaction review visibility

decision.rationale: Users must be made immediately aware of proposed but unapplied redactions.

capabilities.notes: Future UI should expose incoming or locally proposed annotations and make their unapplied state unmistakable. Safe Redacted Copy refuses until they are applied or removed.

knownLimitations: Future UI should expose incoming or locally proposed annotations and make their unapplied state unmistakable. Safe Redacted Copy refuses until they are applied or removed.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Privacy-clean copy and metadata/attachment stripping

decision.rationale: Ordinary saves preserve document context; security workflows need an explicit clean-copy option.

capabilities.notes: Ordinary Save preserves metadata and attachments. Save as Redacted Copy scrubs metadata; users may explicitly strip attachments and create a privacy-clean copy.

knownLimitations: Ordinary Save preserves metadata and attachments. Save as Redacted Copy scrubs metadata; users may explicitly strip attachments and create a privacy-clean copy.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Safe external-link activation

decision.rationale: Useful web links must not become an execution or local-resource boundary escape.

evidence.ref: Adobe Acrobat Trust Manager; Microsoft URI activation security guidance; PDF Association action guidance

capabilities.notes: Allow only deliberate https clicks; http is never followed; mailto confirms; all other schemes and non-URI actions are blocked or copy-only. PDF-controlled action chains never auto-run.

knownLimitations: Allow only deliberate https clicks; http is never followed; mailto confirms; all other schemes and non-URI actions are blocked or copy-only. PDF-controlled action chains never auto-run.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Attachment disclosure, save, and stripping

decision.rationale: Attachments are useful office data but must never execute implicitly or remain hidden from the user.

capabilities.notes: Show attachments in a panel, permit explicit save to disk only, preserve by default, allow stripping on save, and warn when their presence is not otherwise obvious.

knownLimitations: Show attachments in a panel, permit explicit save to disk only, preserve by default, allow stripping on save, and warn when their presence is not otherwise obvious.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Signature invalidation and advisory-permission override

decision.rationale: Users may legitimately edit their documents but must understand signature and permission consequences.

capabilities.notes: Permit editing after an interactive warning that signatures will be invalidated and removed. Permit explicit override of advisory flags such as no-printing; never recover passwords or bypass encryption.

knownLimitations: Permit editing after an interactive warning that signatures will be invalidated and removed. Permit explicit override of advisory flags such as no-printing; never recover passwords or bypass encryption.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: OCR for scanned documents

decision.rationale: OCR is desired, but must wait for an explicit implementation decision and independent redaction-safety evidence.

capabilities.notes: When authorized, track OCR search, selection, review and redaction separately, including accuracy and refusal metrics.

knownLimitations: When authorized, track OCR search, selection, review and redaction separately, including accuracy and refusal metrics.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Local exportable security-action audit log

decision.rationale: Useful for legal and corporate workflows, but intentionally not current scope.

capabilities.notes: Future scope: redaction apply/remove, signature invalidation, attachment extraction/stripping, encryption changes, and external-link launches.

knownLimitations: Future scope: redaction apply/remove, signature invalidation, attachment extraction/stripping, encryption changes, and external-link launches.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Platform-specific printing

decision.rationale: Printing is a future platform-by-platform decision, not a current cross-platform conformance promise.

capabilities.notes: Advanced print-production controls are excluded from product scope.

knownLimitations: Advanced print-production controls are excluded from product scope.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.

capabilities.name: Restricted PDF JavaScript subset research

decision.rationale: Do not execute PDF JavaScript; investigate a bounded common-form subset only if a threat model proves it safe.

capabilities.notes: No general JavaScript engine. Any future subset must have no filesystem, process, network, dynamic loading, or arbitrary execution, plus enforceable CPU, memory, recursion, and document-size limits.

knownLimitations: No general JavaScript engine. Any future subset must have no filesystem, process, network, dynamic loading, or arbitrary execution, plus enforceable CPU, memory, recursion, and document-size limits.
explicitEvidenceGaps: No paired positive and negative/conservation evidence is claimed; do not promote this capability to implemented-and-proven.
